The '''Coral Banks''' were a series of reefs in the [[Southern Passage]], a sea which straddled the southern coastline of [[Alanciar]], a continent on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] planet of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. The Coral Banks were a popular haunt for the [[Alanciari]] [[harvester fleet]]. During [[Quarra Thayn]]'s visit to [[Point Defiance]], her host and lover [[Jogan Halder]] suggested taking her on a rowboat to the Coral Banks on the following morning. This trip never occurred due to the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s invasion of [[Alanciar]] that very night.<ref name="Pandemonium">[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pandemonium]]</ref>
